# B2 vocabulary batch 88

## Scope

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `fantastically`, `foolishly`, `footnote`, `forcefully`, `foresee`, `forestry`, `formerly`, `fox`, `fragrance`, `frankly`, `frantically`, `fraud`, `frigate`, `frontier`, `fulfil`, `functionality`, `funky`, `furiously`, `furor`, `gaiety`, `gambling`, `gangster`, `gasp`, `gateway`, and `gaudy`.

Every entry was manually reviewed for its sense, part of speech, Vietnamese gloss, example pair, IPA, level, and controlled topic assignment. The shared dictionary remains the single source for all exam lists.
